title: Improving Hate Speech Classification with Cross-Taxonomy Dataset Integration
findings: The model, trained with the integrated taxonomy, effectively classified hate speech targeting religious groups. In one evaluation, it achieved F1-scores of 0.99 for both 'Jews' and 0.98 for 'Muslims'. After retraining on a second dataset, it maintained strong performance on the initial dataset with F1-scores of 0.87 for 'Jews' and 0.84 for 'Muslims', demonstrating successful knowledge retention and generalization.
